newsitem.title: USA: Phoenix Gold sees Q4 lower than forecast.
newsitem.headline: Phoenix Gold sees Q4 lower than forecast.

text.p: Phoenix Gold International Inc said Thursday earnings and revenue for its fiscal fourth quarter will come in well short of analysts' estimates.
Analysts had expected the company to report a loss of $0.05 a share for the quarter ended September 30, according to First Call.

The company, which designs and makes high-performance accessories, speakers and electronics for cars, did not say how big of loss it expected to report when it releases its fourth-quarter results on November 7.
The company said its weaker-than-expected performance reflected delayed shipments of new car audio products and vendor supply problems with the Cyclone and XMAX speaker lines.
It also cited lower-than-expected gross margins and greater-than-expected selling, general and administrative costs.
